title: Post Malone Will Offer ‘A Little Help’ in ‘Storm on Sesame Street’ Special
summary: The singer joins Elmo and friends in a new initiative to help families navigate extreme weather situations.
body: Post Malone ‘s next collaboration isn’t with a viral country star, pop singer or a hitmaker producer. It’s with Elmo and friends! Related Post Malone Debuts New Song ‘Chrome Heartbreaker,’ Brings Out Swae Lee at 2026 World Cup Closing Ceremony Post Malone Teases Return to Hip-Hop: ‘That One Mofo That Don’t Know When to Leave’ ‘Sesame Street’ Takes a ‘Golden’ Opportunity With Parody Album, Turns Chappell Roan Hit Into Potty-Training Anthem The genre-blending artist is heading to Sesame Street as a special guest in Storm on Sesame Street , a new special premiering Monday, Aug. 3, on Netflix and PBS KIDS, Sesame Workshop announced on Thursday (July 30). Comedian Michelle Buteau is also participating in the special, which follows Elmo, Abby Cadabby and the rest of the neighborhood as they prepare for a major storm before coming together to help rebuild their community in its aftermath. As part of the special, Post Malone sings “A Little Help,” an upbeat song about banding together to rebuild the neighborhood.
